## Before publishing — contributor and agent checklist

- [ ] I have permission to submit this original code and fixture data under MIT.
- [ ] I reviewed the entire staged/branch diff before pushing, including expected outputs and history.
- [ ] No credentials, cookies, headers, raw HARs, real account/transaction IDs, personal banking records, screenshots or full transcripts are included.
- [ ] Fixtures are labeled synthetic or sanitized; transformations preserve the edge case without identifying anyone.
- [ ] `npm run privacy -- --staged` ran locally; I understand its heuristics do not prove redaction.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes; expected outputs were reviewed independently of the parser.
- [ ] Negative cases cover identity, amount, currency, status, time, duplicates, malformed data and untrusted text.
- [ ] Live claims specify exact revision, outcome and limitations. I did not imply unique humans, cryptographic source proof or guaranteed finality.
